title: arikury schizophylla
intro: Arikury schizophylla, commonly known as Turkey Tail, is a type of fungus belonging to the Polyporaceae family. The plant is rich in antioxidants and has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including boosting the immune system, reducing inflammation, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Turkey Tail include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral properties, and potentially inhibit the growth of cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of Turkey Tail include polysaccharides, particularly beta-glucans, which are responsible for its immune-modulating effects.
